title: Effects of Sedentary Behaviour on Metabolic Parameters
brief_summary: The rates of sedentary activity are increasing. Studies have shown that time spent on doing sedentary activities is an independent risk factor for cardiovascular disease. Prior studies have shown that interrupting inactivity improved the body's handling of blood glucose and gene expression. The investigators plan to explore this further by examining the effects of interrupting 4 hours of inactivity with 2 minutes of moderate intensity exercise every 20 minutes on the following metabolic parameters: blood pressure, cortisol, C-Reactive Protein, glucose and insulin levels.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 65 years of age or older
* type 2 diabetes managed with diet or oral hypoglycemic agents

Exclusion Criteria:

* using insulin to manage diabetes
* baseline of pre-session blood glucose reading equal to or greater than 10 mmol/L
* any medical condition that would limit the ability to perform activity portion of the study
* people not comfortable exercising on a stationary bicycle
* subject answers yes to one of more of the questions in the Physical Activity Readiness Questionnaire
